waybackify check [flags] <wayback-url>

Full wayback-404 verdict for the exact capture

Full wayback-404 verdict for the exact capture: CDX statuscode +
soft-404 content heuristics on the replay body — the #248 audit
primitive.

Output: JSON verdict on stdout
({verdict: good|wayback404|suspect, statuscode, reason, snippet});
exit 0 = verified good, nonzero = bad/suspect.

Arguments:
  <wayback-url>   full web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>/<original> replay URL

Flags:
  --help|-h       Show help

issues: #254 (parent) · #248 (audit) · #249 (mirror)
